\begin{minipage}{0.95\linewidth}\vspace{4pt}\scriptsize \textit{Notes:} Growth of real GDP per capita (five-year averages) on the wage bill (\% of GDP, IMF GFS) in level or in log, with the controls in t\_p $-$ 1 and the country and period fixed effects of the preferred specification, standard errors clustered by country (95\% CI) and wild cluster bootstrap p (Webb weights, 9,999 replications). Samples: (a) the preferred specification; (b) its periods starting in 1999 or later, the first period with WWBI pairs; (c) the registered H2 sample of Table 2, column 3; (d) the strict H2 sample (WWBI pairs in t\_p $-$ 1 to t\_p $-$ 4). In (c) and (d) the wage bill is measured in t\_p $-$ 1, as in the preferred specification, or in the year of the WWBI pair, as in Table 2; rows with the wage bill in t\_p $-$ 1 lose the country-periods where it is missing. Per point of GDP: log coefficient divided by the sample mean of the wage bill (delta method, mean treated as fixed); level coefficients unchanged. Decomposition: the change from the level coefficient in (a) to the log coefficient with the pair-year wage bill in (c), split in the order functional form, period, WWBI countries and timing of the pair; tests and decomposition steps with 95\% CIs from a country pairs bootstrap (999 draws). Exploratory (post-plan, pre-registered in the third plan addendum).\end{minipage}
